title: Sidecar anchor manifest — common base shape
description:
Shared base schema for sidecar anchor manifests (v1.1.18, S1). Defines the 5 required top-level fields every sidecar's anchor_manifest.json MUST carry: manifest_version, generated_at, sidecar, canon_policy_version, view_files. Per-sidecar schemas (skills/<sidecar>/references/anchor_manifest.schema.json) extend this base with sidecar-specific discriminators (diagram_type / bpmn_profile / etc.) + their per-view-file shape. Future 3rd / 4th sidecars (DBML, sequence-diagram, etc.) MUST conform to this base — operators registering a new sidecar in config/sidecar_registry.yaml gain free conformance to the BSA orchestrator's anchor-binding contract.

This base schema is NOT directly referenced by F5 (the per-sidecar schemas under skills/<sidecar>/references/ remain the F5-validated artifacts since they're more specific). It IS pinned by tests/test_sidecar_registry.py + scripts/sidecar_registry_lint.py to catch the case where a per-sidecar schema accidentally drops a base requirement.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. v1.0 today; bump on breaking shape changes.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this manifest was emitted.

sidecar.description: Sidecar name (matches the skill directory under skills/). Per-sidecar schemas pin this to a const value.

sidecar_version.description: Optional sidecar release version (semver). Recorded for downstream provenance.

canon_policy_version.description: BSA canon policy version at the time of emission. Lets the orchestrator detect canon drift between emission + consumption.

view_files.description: One element per emitted view file. Per-sidecar schemas constrain the per-element shape (path extension + discriminator field + anchor_map shape). Base schema only requires that view_files is a non-empty array.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the emitted view file (e.g., analysis/views/c4/system_context.puml).

anchor_map.description: One entry per view-element-to-A61-anchor binding. Per-sidecar schemas constrain the entry shape.
